picks.headline: BandLab Technologies buys Aiode, an AI music studio built on 'fully-licensed' audio
picks.excerpt: BandLab Technologies acquired Aiode, an AI-powered music studio that lets creators build tracks using audio-to-audio models developed with professional session musicians. Its distinguishing pitch is that 100% of the training audio is licensed and traceable. Creators can generate performances section by section, spin up alternate takes and export projects as stems or full mixes - positioning it as a 'responsible' route for making music with AI.
picks.rationale: A licensed-by-design AI music studio joining BandLab is a concrete signal of where 'responsible' generative music tooling is heading for creators. NOTE: content-overlaps the already-published card 'bandlab-aiode' (07-26, digitalmusicnews); kept only because the orchestrator directed floor-3 on this exhausted beat.
